cohort: 100 obstetric patients diagnosed with pregnancy-induced hypertension (PIH) admitted to the Critical Care Unit (CCU) at SNMMCH, DHANBAD, Jharkhand, India.
finding: Preeclampsia, nulliparity, unbooked status, and lower segment cesarean section were prevalent, with blood product transfusion as the most common intervention, and a low overall maternal mortality rate (10%).
